owner_names: SL SPV-2, L.P.; SLTA SPV-2, L.P.; SLTA SPV-2 (GP), L.L.C.; Silver Lake Group, L.L.C.; Egon Durban
footnote_text: SL SPV-2, L.P., Silver Lake Partners IV, L.P., Silver Lake Partners V DE (AIV), L.P. and certain of their respective affiliates initiated in-kind distributions of shares of Class C Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share ("Class C Common Stock") of Dell Technologies Inc. (the "Issuer") on October 15, 2026. The receipt of shares of Class C Common Stock by each of the Reporting Persons in connection with such distributions was exempt from reporting pursuant to Rule 16a-13 of the Exchange Act. || These securities are held by SL SPV-2, L.P. The general partner of SL SPV-2, L.P. is SLTA SPV-2, L.P. and the general partner of SLTA SPV-2, L.P. is SLTA SPV-2 (GP), L.L.C. || Silver Lake Group, L.L.C. ("SLG") is the managing member of SLTA SPV-2 (GP), L.L.C. Egon Durban, who serves as a director of the Issuer, also serves as the CEO and a Managing Member of SLG. Each of the Reporting Persons may be deemed a director by deputization of the Issuer.
